entities.name: Leaf
entities.description: An elder elf of Savaea, formerly named Whisper and Brookcharm, who sought to teach Kruuna the cycle of life and death and was killed.

entities.name: Busjaw
entities.description: Groveling goblin messenger interrogated by Leaf.

entities.name: Kruuna
entities.description: Goblin chieftess who used an Ivory Cup to stay immortal and was shot dead by the elves.

entities.name: Ivory Cup
entities.description: Cup Kruuna used to stay immortal, no longer filled with white mana.

entities.name: Oneah
entities.description: Nation whose destruction stopped the cup working.

entities.name: Elves of Savaea
entities.description: Elves who shot Kruuna with arrows.

events.summary: Around 4180 AR, single goblins from the Red Mountains each bring a rock glyph into Savaea's woods.
events.quote: each carrying a single rock glyph

events.summary: Leaf interrogates Busjaw, learning the goblins ask for help for their chieftess Kruuna.
events.quote: each of the goblins had been sent as messengers asking for help from the elves on behalf of their chieftess, Kruuna

events.summary: Kruuna shows Leaf the Ivory Cup that no longer holds white mana.
events.quote: Leaf then offered to take the chief to Savaea

events.summary: Kruuna clubs Leaf's head, cracking her skull, and the elves shoot Kruuna dead.
events.quote: the goblin clubbed Leaf's head, cracking her skull

relations.quote: the goblin clubbed Leaf's head, cracking her skull
The elves immediately shot Kruuna full of arrows, killing her on the spot.
